title: selinum stelliphorum
intro: Selinum stelliphorum, commonly known as Starry Celery or Wild Celery, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic activities that may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Selinum stelliphorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents in Selinum stelliphorum may also contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations.
